content:
# 中文回答

标签客户问冷烫和热烫怎么选，应该先看生产方式和目标效果。热烫适合需要强金属质感、局部高端装饰、酒标、美妆标签、防伪标签等场景。它依靠烫金版、温度、压力和停留时间，立体感和边缘质感通常更强。

冷烫更适合联线、高速、柔印或标签批量生产。它通常先通过印刷单元上胶，再把箔层转移到胶层区域，效率高，适合大批量标签和可变设计组合。但冷烫效果依赖 UV 胶、底材表面、网点控制和膜匹配，不能简单认为所有膜都通用。

专业建议：如果客户追求高端质感和厚重金属效果，先考虑热烫；如果客户追求高速联线和大面积标签装饰，考虑冷烫。最终仍要用客户真实标签材料、油墨和设备做测试。

# English Answer

When label customers ask whether to use hot foil or cold foil, start with production method and target effect. Hot foil stamping is suitable for strong metallic effects, premium local decoration, wine labels, cosmetic labels, and security labels. It uses a heated die, pressure, and dwell time, often giving stronger tactile and edge definition.

Cold foil is better for inline, high-speed flexo or label production. Adhesive or UV adhesive is applied first, and foil transfers only to the adhesive area. It is efficient for large-volume label work and decorative combinations. However, cold foil performance depends on UV adhesive, substrate surface, dot control, and foil compatibility.

A practical rule: use hot foil for premium depth and strong metallic finish; use cold foil for high-speed inline label decoration. Always test with the real label substrate, ink, adhesive, and machine.
